g.title: ChironFlagshipArchitecture
g.text: The simple model: tokens become q, attention writes into p, q is normalized and read out, training reverses the stack.

g.title: block_note
g.text: q_l is never overwritten by attention.
QK-Norm stabilizes Q/K at long context.
This additive shear is easy to invert.
q_{l+1} = ReLN(q_l). On the last layer only, p is folded into q before ReLN so the readout sees the accumulated attention signal.
